# THE ROSEWOOD (11 · rosewood)

An Art Deco grand hotel: generative sunburst, gold shimmer, and an elevator-dial scroll indicator.

- **Technique:** DECO SVG
- **Tags:** art deco, luxury, gold, green, vintage, elegant, hotel, 1920s
- **Best for:** hotels; restaurants; wine & cocktail bars; weddings & events
- **Fonts:** Marcellus, Montserrat
- **Fonts href:** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Marcellus&family=Montserrat:wght@300;400;500&display=swap`
- **Swatch:** #0b2b22 · #d4af6a · #f0d9a8
- **Dependencies:** none beyond the shared helpers
- **Source:** `src/templates/rosewood/` (Template.astro, content.ts, deco.ts, effects.ts, meta.ts, style.css, theme.css)

## Signature effects
- `deco.ts`
  - `sunburstSvg()` — The 900×900 hero sunburst: 48 rays, concentric rings and eight stepped arcs.
  - `decoTopSvg` — Peaked ornament above the hero heading.
  - `brandMarkSvg` — Five-stroke skyline mark used in the wordmark.
  - `glyphSvg`
  - `liftDialSvg()` — Static face of the elevator dial: rim, seven ticks, needle group (id `needle`) and hub.
- `effects.ts`
  - `spinSunburst(svg: SVGElement)` — Rotate the hero sunburst a hair every frame (skipped under reduced motion).
  - `initLiftDial(dial: SVGElement, floorLabel: HTMLElement, floors: string[])` — Swing the dial needle 0–180° with page scroll and name the floor it points at.

## Content model — `content.ts`
Every user-visible string lives here. Fields ending in `Html` are trusted inline HTML (`<em> <b> <i> <br> <a> <span>`).

```ts
/** Fields ending in `Html` are trusted, author-written HTML (inline <em>/<b>/<a>/<br>/<span> only). */
export interface Link {
  label: string;
  href: string;
}

/** Line-art ornament drawn above a suite card. */
export type SuiteGlyph = 'fan' | 'chevron' | 'arch';

export interface Suite {
  /** Which Art Deco ornament to draw. */
  glyph: SuiteGlyph;
  name: string;
  /** Floor and size line, e.g. "Floor XII · 68 m²". */
  floor: string;
  description: string;
  /** Price line, shown in gold. */
  rate: string;
}

export interface Evening {
  /** Time and place, e.g. "19:00 — Lobby". */
  hour: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
}

export interface Content {
  seo: { title: string; description: string; ogTitle?: string; ogDescription?: string };
  /** Hotel name in the nav and footer wordmark. */
  brand: string;
  /** Nav links (hidden below 900px). Hrefs target section ids. */
  nav: Link[];
  /** Labels the elevator dial cycles through as the page scrolls, lobby first. */
  floors: string[];
  hero: {
    /** Small line above the heading. */
    est: string;
    /** Heading; wrap the shimmering part in `<span class="gold">`. */
    headingHtml: string;
    sub: string;
    cta: Link;
    /** Line pinned to the bottom of the hero (desktop only). */
    foot: string;
  };
  suites: {
    /** Anchor id of the section (nav links target it). */
    id: string;
    kicker: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    items: Suite[];
  };
  evenings: {
    id: string;
    kicker: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    items: Evening[];
  };
  quote: {
    id: string;
    quoteHtml: string;
    cite: string;
  };
  footer: {
    /** Address / tagline under the footer wordmark. */
    noteHtml: string;
    /** Credit line; the showcase line is appended on showcase routes. */
    creditHtml: string;
  };
}
```
